remarks: Fabulous 3-bedroom, 3.5-bath ranch perfectly situated on one of Stamford's most desirable streets. Set on a beautiful, level property with a spacious backyard, this home offers the ideal combination of comfort, convenience, and easy one-level living. The light-filled living and dining rooms create an inviting atmosphere, while the sunroom provides the perfect spot to enjoy morning coffee, evening tea, or simply relax with views of the backyard. The partially finished lower level offers flexible space ideal for a family room, playroom, home office, or gym. Nature lovers will appreciate being within walking distance of the Stamford Museum & Nature Center, featuring live animals, educational programs, and year-round seasonal activities. Also nearby is the Bartlett Arboretum & Gardens, offering miles of scenic walking trails and beautiful gardens. Conveniently located within walking distance of Northeast Elementary School and just minutes from shopping, dining, and major commuting routes. A wonderful opportunity to enjoy a sought-after Stamford location and all the comforts of home. Just what you've been looking for!
